item.title: TTT 352: Funnel Vision
item.description:
It’s our first post-Eurovision 2013 show. So things are getting as back to normal as we do here at Tip Tap Tip HQ. By normal we mean Rachelle tries to derail Eric’s careful planning and preparation.  It’s worked for over 350 episodes so why stop now?
